text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates bus service on The West Mall, City Council approval of this report is required. The TTC has been advised of this matter. The purpose of this report is to recommend that the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the east side of The West Mall between Holiday Drive and a point 152.5 metres south, be amended to prohibit standing at all times. The proposed standing prohibition was requested by an area resident, in consultation with Transportation staff and the Ward Councillor, to address concerns regarding vehicles parked within the area currently designated as "No Parking Anytime".

City Council on February 26, 2020, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of The West Mall, between Holiday Drive and a point 152.5 metres south. 2. City Council prohibit standing at all times on the east side of The West Mall, between Holiday Drive and a point 152.5 metres south.
